theme_and_archetype.vibe: Quiet luxury, premium psychology paper, Scandinavian minimal, clinical yet warm, Headspace x editorial.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Patients need warmth, calm, and trust. A highly professional 'editorial' aesthetic instills confidence, while natural earthy tones provide psychological safety.

background.name: Paper-Cream
background.usage: Primary app background. Gives a tactile, physical paper feel instead of harsh digital white.

surface.name: Soft White
surface.usage: Card backgrounds, AI chat bubbles, and elevated containers.

primary.name: Deep Moss
primary.usage: Primary buttons, user chat bubbles, major headings, and the 4-digit hero code. Replaces the old sage for higher contrast and luxury feel.

secondary.name: Sage Green
secondary.usage: Inactive states, borders, subtle separators, and secondary UI elements.

accent.name: Terracotta
accent.usage: Active states (e.g., selected Likert button), severity tags, and primary CTAs needing urgent visual weight.

primary.name: Graphite
primary.usage: Main body text. Never use pure black.

display.usage: Hero 4-digit code, massive titles, and quiet luxury moments. Excellent Hungarian diacritic support.

body.usage: UI elements, chat bubbles, buttons, quiz questions. Highly readable, geometric yet warm.

myra_avatar.usage: Myra (AI) avatar in chat bubbles and side drawer.

result_hero_bg.usage: Subtle abstract background for the 4-digit code hero screen.

layout_rules.global: Mobile-first execution. Use max-w-md mx-auto on web to simulate the app constraints, or full width if native.
layout_rules.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 and p-8 for major containers. Let the UI breathe.

login_screen.hero: Render the ESV logo (/app/frontend/assets/images/esv-logo.png) centered, generous top margin.
login_screen.action: Google Login button: White bg, Deep Moss border (border-[#2B3A30]), Graphite text. Minimalist, no heavy shadows.

quiz_question_card.container: White surface, subtle shadow, rounded-2xl, p-6.
quiz_question_card.question_text: Graphite text, text-xl, Manrope font, generous line height.

likert_scale.inactive: White bg, 1px solid Sage (#6B7D70/40), Graphite text.
likert_scale.active: Terracotta bg (#C07C66), pure White text, no border.

quiz_result_hero.container: Full height/viewport focus. Use result_hero_bg as a very faint background layer (opacity-30).
quiz_result_hero.code_reveal: The 4-digit code is the absolute center. Deep Moss text, Cormorant Garamond, text-6xl tracking-[0.2em].
quiz_result_hero.severity_tag: Inline flex, rounded-full px-3 py-1 bg-[#C07C66]/10 text-[#C07C66] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest.

chat_interface.myra_bubble: White bg, rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none, p-4, Graphite text. Avatar: 32x32px rounded-full using myra_avatar.
chat_interface.user_bubble: Deep Moss bg (#2B3A30), rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none, p-4, Paper-Cream text.
chat_interface.separator_pill: Used for code changes. Centered. Sage bg with 10% opacity (bg-[#6B7D70]/10), Sage text, uppercase caption font. e.g. 'ÚJ MÉRÉS: 2134'.
chat_interface.input_bar: Fixed at bottom. White bg, border-t border-[#6B7D70]/20. Deep Moss send icon.

side_drawer.state_badge: Large prominent badge displaying the current 4-digit code (e.g. 'ÁLLAPOT: 3124'). Terracotta text on Deep Moss bg with Terracotta border.
side_drawer.nav_items: Manrope text-lg, active state gets a slight Terracotta left-border indicator.

testing_rules.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: 'login-google-button', 'quiz-likert-button-3', 'chat-input-field', 'chat-send-button', 'drawer-toggle', 'hero-state-code'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. Do not introduce pure blacks, bright blues, or standard 'app' colors.
Implement typography changes carefully, ensuring Cormorant Garamond is imported and applied to headings, and Manrope to the body.
Ensure all Hungarian diacritics render correctly.
Rely entirely on the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Make sure the Shadcn components (if used) are heavily customized to strip their default Vercel-like borders/shadows, aligning with the Organic & Earthy quiet luxury aesthetic.
